registered: before any ETF flow number was analysed (the page was only parsed for its format)
hypothesis: US spot-bitcoin ETF net flows measure institutional demand that keeps arriving for days (allocation decisions are spread out); a strong 5-day flow impulse predicts BTC drift over the next days.
data: research_data/etf/farside_btc.html (Farside Investors, all US spot BTC ETFs, daily total net flow in US$ m, 2024-01-11..2026-10-29, saved by the user)
timing: flow of US trading day D is used from 00:00 UTC of D+2 (publication can be late on D+1 UTC), held until the next value
signal: f5 = sum of the last 5 daily total flows; z = f5 / sd of f5 over the previous 120 trading days (min 60); BTC perp position = 0.5 x clip(z / 2, -1, 1)
costs: 5.5 bp taker + 0.5 bp half spread per unit turnover; Binance BTC funding
